text:
Ravi (Finance): Quick interim policy note for teams — short-term change to PO thresholds while we finalize the Q3 budget. Effective immediately: any single vendor invoice >= $6,000 needs a PO. Recurring subscriptions >= $2,000/month also need a PO. Please don't sign new contracts that exceed these without routing through Procurement. :megaphone:

Nora (Procurement): To clarify: 
- Emergency production purchases still follow the "PROC EMERGENCY" flow (email oncall-finance@redwood.com).
- Small one-offs under $6k can use corporate cards but must include project_tag + cost_center on the statement. Missing tags = auto-flag.

Sam (AP): Operational note: invoices without PO that meet the threshold will be put on hold in AP. If you expect delayed payment issues because of hold, include a note to ap@redwood.com and cc procure@redwood.com so we can triage faster.

Jun (Eng): Question  what about trial credits from cloud providers billed as a single invoice ~$5.8k? Need retro-PO?

Nora (Procurement): If it's under $6k and one-off, card is fine. If vendor invoices later and amount crosses $6k, we will ask for a retro-PO. Retro-POs are limited — explain why it couldn't be pre-approved. Use this template when requesting retro-PO: 
```
Vendor: <name>
Amount: <USD>
Project: <project_tag>
Reason: <why retro>
Requested by: <owner email>
```
Send to procure@redwood.com with subject "Retro-PO request".

Carmen (Sales): Heads-up: customer-facing promo credits sometimes push us over thresholds in aggregate. Can Sales request a pre-approved PO for a bundle of credits?

Ravi (Finance): Yes — Sales Ops can request a single PO for promo bundles. Include expected total and timebox (e.g., Q3 campaign). We'll prioritize these requests if tagged "sales-promo".

Legal: Reminder: any vendor that will have access to customer data, or be used to run customer demos on our infra, must complete contract intake before signature. No exceptions. Use https://intra.redwood.com/contract-intake and tag "legal-review".

ProcureBot: SYSTEM: Auto-check enabled. Invoices >= $6,000 without PO will trigger AP hold and a Slack DM to the requester. Vendors with outstanding security docs will be flagged as "onboarding-required".

Jun (Eng): We have a short POC with "FluxBench" expected to bill $7k total across two invoices. Could we get a short PO?

Nora (Procurement): Yes — for POCs, request a "PO: POC" in the onboarding form and cap the total. We can issue a short-duration PO (30-90 days) if Security confirms scope. If it's infra-facing, include the security contact in the request.

Sam (AP): Quick tagging example finance expects on card/PO lines: 
```
project_tag=redwood-infer-opt
cost_center=eng-runtime
deployment=dedicated|hosted|private
```
Missing these will delay processing.

Ravi (Finance): TL;DR: temporary PO threshold is $6k for single invoices and $2k/month for recurring. Card OK below $6k but tag everything. Use retro-PO only when necessary. Contract intake + Legal = required for vendors touching data/infra. We'll revisit thresholds after the Q3 budget review. Thanks all. :handshake:
